cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'All part of the entertainment'—I've told the guests what you told them. Let's spare Grandad an interrogation about the fire.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that about the magician. Grandad set fire to the gazebo.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, that part. From now on it's 'Everyone's fine; we're eating indoors.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Grandad's asking me whether he should apologize when he makes his speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to thank everyone for coming indoors. We'll use his words when anyone asks.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 repeats B's entertainment reassurance while protecting Grandad, but it could be a knowing cover story rather than actual S04 misunderstanding.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 magician explanation informs A3 new wording; B4 apology request directly produces A5 thanks instead.

relationship.evidence: B4 relays Grandad's real wish to apologize, a plausible family concern beyond feeding a joke.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes Grandad the source of the common line because B4 gives him a speech.

specificity.evidence: A1 guests and fire, B2 gazebo and magician, and A3 indoor meal establish the party.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 yes that part is deliberately evasive; A5 thanks and shared words each have a practical purpose.
